name: impact-assessment
title: Impact assessment record
for_each: select id,external_id from changes order by external_id

sections.title: Assessment history
sections.sql: select version,decision,rationale,assessed_by,created_at from assessments where change_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Implementation actions
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_date,status,completed_version from actions where change_id=$1 order by due_date

sections.title: Sign-off record
sections.sql: select version,signed_by,reason,created_at from signoffs where change_id=$1 order by created_at

name: evidence-pack
title: Implementation evidence pack
for_each: select id,external_id from changes order by external_id

sections.title: Evidence references
sections.note: References must be checked against the original documents. A record here is not proof of legal compliance.
sections.sql: select a.title,e.version,e.reference,e.description,e.recorded_by,e.retention_review,e.legal_hold from actions a join evidence e on e.action_id=a.id where a.change_id=$1 order by e.created_at

sections.title: Recorded activity
sections.sql: select event,actor,created_at from history where entity_id=$1 order by created_at
